purpose: Define the root non-overridable Core invariants already required by canonical addressing, bounded operation, value inertness, capability/authority separation, namespace roots and automation dispatch.

semantics.purpose: Group the exact root Core invariant and hard-gate records owned by the Core Invariants contract.

metadata.owner_scope_rule: Constraint identities are owner-scoped and are therefore classified in a Topic declared by their defining contract.

semantics.root_rule: These invariants are the non-overridable Core floor. Child/domain contracts may narrow behavior more strictly but may not weaken them.
semantics.identity_rule: Machine-significant identities and references resolve explicitly; labels, paths and proximity are not identity.
semantics.data_rule: Canonical/model/tool/imported data is inert until an explicit governed operation creates an effect.
semantics.authority_rule: Data, ownership, Topic membership, capability availability, connection state and model output do not create authorization.
semantics.capability_rule: Undefined capabilities do not exist and installed/discovered capability is distinct from enabled/authorized execution.
semantics.bounds_rule: Dynamic recursion, traversal, retries, queueing and execution are explicitly bounded.
semantics.address_rule: Roots, namespaces and addresses resolve through declared canonical semantics and never by dynamic path guessing.
semantics.causality_rule: Execution causality is explicit; time, adjacency, layout and correlation alone do not establish cause.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identities and references are exact and never selected through fuzzy/path/newest/mtime inference.
Data, model output, tool result and imported content remain inert until an explicit validated operation crosses an effect boundary.
Authority is never created by payload data, Topic membership, semantic ownership, UI visibility, connectivity or successful parsing.
A capability must be explicitly defined and available before it can be considered for execution; availability remains separate from authorization.
Dynamic canonical and runtime operations are bounded and fail closed when required bounds cannot be established.
Reserved roots, namespaces and semantic addresses resolve only through explicit canonical declarations.
Causal execution links are explicit; timestamps, adjacency, correlation and visual layout are evidence or presentation only.

hard_gates.condition: required semantic identity or reference resolves ambiguously or by heuristic fallback
runtime authority would be created from data, ownership, Topic grouping, availability, connectivity or UI state without explicit authorization
required recursion, traversal, retry, queue or execution bound is absent or unknown

references.purpose: Child invariants may narrow but never weaken the root Core invariant floor.
Exact identity resolution implements the root identity invariant.
Bounded operation implements the root boundedness invariant.

prose.summary: Root non-overridable Core invariant floor reconstructed from exact active references already present in the supplied base specification.
notes: Added in Clean Staging Pass 5 because the supplied source contained eight exact references to this identity but no active definition.
Topic classification is provided by the existing TOPIC_CORE_INVARIANTS definition in AIGMOS_CORE_INVARIANT_HIERARCHY_CONTRACT; no duplicate Topic definition is introduced.
